div.div: Legend: grey band with a header strip is one resource container. Coloured tag is the HTTP method: green GET, blue POST, yellow PUT, red DELETE. Blue row is one route with its handler function. No row carries a lock: no route checks a caller.

text.tspan: Legend: grey band with a header strip is one resource container. Coloured tag is the HTTP method:
green GET, blue POST, yellow PUT, red DELETE. Blue row is one route with its handler function. No
row carries a lock: no route checks a caller.
